dropdown.$description: Layer of dropdowns, selects, comboboxes and date pickers. Above page content, below popovers.

popover.$description: Layer of popovers and action menus. Above dropdowns.

sheet.$description: Layer of side sheets. The scrim uses this value and the panel uses this value + 1 (calc).

dialog.$description: Layer of dialogs and their overlay. Above sheets, because a dialog can open from a sheet.

toast.$description: Layer of toasts. Above dialogs so confirmations stay visible; below tooltips.

tooltip.$description: Layer of tooltips. The highest layer in the system. Do not add layers above it.
